problem.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
twoFactor.codeHint: The 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Each recovery code works only once.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the e-mail address of your account and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.

setup.title: Welcome to IntraWatch
setup.intro: Create the owner account. It can manage everything in this instance.
setup.workspaceHint: For example your company or team name. You can rename it later.
setup.timezoneHint: Used for dates, maintenance windows and reports.
setup.done: Setup complete. You are signed in.

relogin.title: Your session has expired
relogin.intro: Sign in again to continue. Your unsaved changes stay on the page and are sent once you are back.

confirmPassword.title: Confirm your password
confirmPassword.intro: This is a sensitive action. Enter your password to continue.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.enabledText: Signing in requires a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.disabledText: Protect your account with a time-based code from an authenticator app.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for setting up the authenticator app
twoFactor.secret: Cannot scan it? Enter this key manually:
twoFactor.codesIntro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one lets you sign in once without your phone. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.regenerateConfirm: Your current recovery codes stop working and new ones are shown once.
twoFactor.disableConfirm: Signing in will only need your password. You can turn it on again at any time.
